info.name: IDEA usage counter
info.summary: Counts daily Nextcloud app opens by group for the IDEA usage hook
info.description:
A small IDEA helper that counts full-page app opens for logged-in users.
It stores only `(day, group, app id) → n`. Group is admin, teacher or learner (the same mapping as Office opens and shares: admin wins, then the teachers group, otherwise learner). No user ids, paths or file names are stored.
The App Disk usage hook reads the table for `appsOpened`. This app has no UI.
info.author: IDEA
